protocol.baseline: expanding historical mean of matured labels
protocol.model: expanding historical univariate OLS of matured future returns on lagged liquidity scores
protocol.limitation: Historical raw inputs are the latest revised values, not original publication vintages. Quarterly outcomes overlap; errors and small samples are not independent evidence of significance.

predictiveBacktest.detail: Revised-data pseudo-out-of-sample linear model vs expanding-mean baseline; two-quarter signal lag, matured labels only; NOT a genuine real-time vintage test.

revisionStability.detail: At least six independently archived real ECOS publication vintages with per-observation revisions are required; generated score fingerprints alone do not prove stability.

humanReview.detail: Technical audit recommends HOLD: OOS forecast skill, revisions, release-date leakage, seasonality and credit overlap require independent human signoff.

observations: The liquidity score has no demonstrated incremental forecasting advantage at both horizons.
Source series may have retrospective revisions not represented in the sole saved score snapshot.
Quarterly GDP, CPI and M2 release calendars need as-of validation; a two-quarter lag reduces but does not eliminate revision bias.
Marshall K ratios using nominal GDP times four warrant seasonality and denominator-unit cross-check.
Liquidity is not synonymous with a house-price crash probability; check overlap with the credit pillar.
An external qualified human must explicitly review before activation.
